attempts.objective: Do not connect a wallet or sign anything. On revoke.cash, type the public address 'vitalik.eth' into the address search box at the top of the page and press Enter to open its approvals page. Select a network from the network selector (for example 'Ethereum'). Wait for loading to finish and check that a list of token approvals is shown. Then open the sort control and choose 'Newest to Oldest'. Then apply any filter or search by an approved spender address using the filter/search controls above the list. Never press 'Revoke', 'Approve', 'Confirm' or any button that moves funds, and never connect a wallet. Assert that after loading, a list of token approvals is shown for the selected network, the list can be sorted by 'Newest to Oldest', and after applying a filter or spender search the list shows only the matching approvals.
